title: Subtree of Another Tree
hints: You need a helper function to check if two trees are identical
At each node in root, check if the subtree starting there matches subRoot
If root is null, subRoot cannot be a subtree of it
Recurse on root.left and root.right if the current node does not match

solution.ts.name: isSubtree
solution.ts.description: Define isSubtree that accepts two tree roots
